t: You're at the spot on Newman Street where Banksy painted One Nation Under CCTV in 2007. It was a mural on the wall of a Royal Mail building, showing a child in a red hooded top painting those words while a police officer and a dog watched. A real CCTV camera sat right beside it. In 2008 Westminster City Council ordered it removed, calling it an unlicensed commercial, and it was painted over in April 2009. Banksy is the anonymous street artist known for stencilled, darkly funny political art.
